title: Structural insight into dynamic switching mechanism of the SAM-IV riboswitch revealed by molecular simulations
task: Characterize SAM-IV riboswitch conformational dynamics and ligand-binding mechanism
key_results: 32 µs MD simulations reveal SAM-bound state has restricted ensemble with lower local fluctuations; apo state shows broader structural variability with redistribution of tertiary contacts; ensemble docking indicates multiple apo conformations retain SAM-binding capacity
comments: The study correctly identifies this as a simulation-derived hypothesis requiring experimental validation; reliance on scoring functions with limited energetic resolution for docking interpretation is a notable limitation.

outputs: 4 µs MD trajectories per state (8 total trajectories, 32 µs aggregate)

inputs: Conformations sampled from apo and ligand-removed MD trajectories

hypotheses.hypothesis: SAM-bound state is conformationally restricted compared to apo state
hypotheses.result: Supported: SAM-bound ensemble shows lower local fluctuations and restricted conformational space

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ligand removal redistributes tertiary contacts and increases structural variability
hypotheses.result: Supported: Apo state exhibits broader structural variability and altered contact patterns

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple apo-state conformations retain capacity to bind SAM
hypotheses.result: Supported by ensemble docking: several apo-derived conformations accommodate SAM with favorable MM-GBSA scores

title: Experimental limitations introduced during cluster analysis in super-resolution microscopy due to the choice of labeling methods and fluorophores
task: Quantify labeling-induced errors in super-resolution microscopy nanocluster quantification
key_results: Antibody-based dSTORM shows ~42% quantification error relative to PALM for FAK nanoclusters; error decreases with smaller probes or monovalent nanobodies; identifies clonality, fluorophores per antibody, steric hindrance, and blinking as major error contributors
comments: Using FAK focal adhesion clusters as a benchmark system is well-designed, but the 42% error ceiling implies significant practical limitations for clinical translation of SMLM-based cluster quantification.

inputs: Focal adhesion kinase (FAK) protein clusters (2D benchmark system)
Labeling parameters (probe size, fluorophore count, antibody clonality)
Experimental imaging parameters (blinking statistics, localization precision)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Antibody-based labeling introduces larger quantification errors than smaller probes
hypotheses.result: Supported: dSTORM shows ~42% error; error decreases with monovalent nanobodies and smaller probes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple labeling factors (antibody clonality, fluorophores per antibody, steric hindrance, blinking) systematically affect cluster quantification accuracy
hypotheses.result: Supported: Study identifies and quantifies contribution of each parameter to total error

title: A novel of synthetic iridoid glycoside, Picroside II inhibits temozolomide resistance proliferation by upregulating DHRS2 in glioblastoma
task: Overcome temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma via DHRS2 upregulation
key_results: Picroside II inhibited TMZ-resistant GBM proliferation, migration, invasion, and clonogenicity; induced G1 phase arrest and dose-dependent mitochondrial apoptosis; NGS identified DHRS2 upregulation; xenograft model showed tumor suppression with enhanced DHRS2
comments: DHRS2 as mechanistic mediator is identified by transcriptomics but functional validation through DHRS2 perturbation experiments would strengthen causality.

inputs: PII alone or combined with TMZ

hypotheses.hypothesis: Picroside II overcomes TMZ resistance by inducing mitochondrial apoptosis and cell cycle arrest
hypotheses.result: PII induces G1 arrest, mitochondrial apoptosis, and modulates key regulatory proteins in dose-dependent manner

hypotheses.hypothesis: DHRS2 upregulation mediates PII antitumor effects
hypotheses.result: NGS identified marked DHRS2 upregulation; xenograft tumors showed enhanced DHRS2 expression correlating with growth suppression

title: G3BP1-induced retrograde transport blockade triggers HSC activation and liver fibrosis via COPI alternative splicing
task: Identify molecular mechanisms of hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrogenesis
key_results: G3BP1 upregulation in fibrotic liver; G3BP1 ablation attenuates HSC activation and fibrotic progression; G3BP1 regulates COPI alternative splicing via hnRNPM phosphorylation, triggering ER stress
comments: Novel G3BP1/SRPK1/hnRNPM/COPI axis uncovered through multi-omics; therapeutic potential demonstrated pharmacologically.

model_io.model: Human LX-2 HSCs and primary mouse HSCs

hypotheses.hypothesis: G3BP1 promotes COPI alternative splicing via hnRNPM to impair retrograde transport and trigger ER stress
hypotheses.result: Accumulation of exon-deficient COPG1/COPB2 isoforms impairs COPI-dependent transport and induces ER stress driving HSC activation

title: Influenza A virus orchestrates ciliated cell fate and injury during the mucociliary damage repair cycle
task: Elucidate mechanisms of persistent mucociliary clearance dysfunction after influenza A infection
key_results: In vivo MCC impairment persists >14 days post-H1N1 PR8 infection with impaired ciliary activity and sustained mucus hypersecretion; IFN–IDO1–AhR axis drives ciliated-to-mucous transdifferentiation; viral M2 protein suppresses TP73–FOXJ1–RFX3 axis and promotes FOXJ1 proteasomal degradation
comments: Dual host and viral pathways identified; persistent MCC dysfunction mechanistically linked to both immune-mediated transdifferentiation and direct viral proteasomal degradation of ciliary determinants.

model_io.model: In vivo H1N1 PR8-infected male mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFN signaling activates IDO1–AhR axis to drive ciliated-to-mucous transdifferentiation
hypotheses.result: Immune-mediated fate transition identified through lineage tracing and multi-omics in H1N1-infected bronchial epithelium

hypotheses.hypothesis: Viral M2 protein impairs ciliary homeostasis by suppressing TP73–FOXJ1–RFX3 regulatory axis
hypotheses.result: M2 protein promotes FOXJ1 proteasomal degradation and suppresses ciliary determinant expression

title: Fermentates of barley polysaccharides by Bifidobacterium longum suppress colorectal cancer associated with modulation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling and metabolic profiles
task: Suppress colorectal cancer through Wnt/β-catenin pathway modulation by barley polysaccharide fermentates
key_results: BLF inhibited HT-29 proliferation via G1 arrest and apoptosis; AOM/DSS model showed reduced tumor burden and normalized serum MPO; Wnt3a/β-catenin/c-Myc downregulation; Dodecyl-β-D-maltoside demonstrated selective cytotoxicity and β-catenin suppression
comments: Metabolomic link between fermentation products and pathway suppression established; clinical translation requires further validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: BLF suppresses CRC via modulation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling
hypotheses.result: BLF downregulates Wnt3a/β-catenin/c-Myc and upregulates pathway inhibitors (Axin1, Apc, Gsk-3β)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fermentation-derived metabolites mediate anti-CRC effects
hypotheses.result: Dodecyl-β-D-maltoside exhibits concentration-dependent cytotoxicity to cancer cells with β-catenin/c-Myc suppression

title: Single-cell transcriptomic profiling reveals novel stem cell markers for corneal limbal epithelium homeostasis
task: Identify novel stem cell markers for corneal limbal epithelium homeostasis
key_results: scRNA-seq of 20,351 cells identified 13 clusters; Gabrp and Alcam identified as limbus-exclusive LSC markers alongside known stemness genes; DEGs associated with stemness pathways including Fmo1, Fmo2
comments: Novel markers validated by multiple modalities (qPCR, Western blot, immunofluorescence); functional validation of markers remains needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LSCs possess unique transcriptomic signature distinct from differentiated limbal cells
hypotheses.result: EGFP+ cluster enriched for Gabrp, Alcam, Fmo1/2, and other stemness-associated genes exclusively or predominantly in limbus

title: Photocrosslinked gelatin hydrogel-mediated IGF-1 delivery promotes early cartilage-like tissue formation in a rabbit auricular defect model
task: Promote cartilage-like tissue formation in auricular defects using controlled IGF-1 delivery
key_results: IGF-1-loaded photocrosslinked gelatin hydrogel occupied 83.8% vs 6.4% of defect in control; increased COL2A1, ACAN, SOX9, COL1A1 expression and Ki-67+ cells; prolonged IGF-1 retention over 14 days
comments: Hydrogel successfully extends IGF-1 half-life and induces chondrocyte differentiation; long-term maturation and mechanical properties not yet assessed.

inputs: IGF-1-loaded or unloaded photocrosslinked gelatin hydrogel
outputs: local IGF-1 retention kinetics over 14 days

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prolonged local IGF-1 retention from hydrogel promotes chondrocyte proliferation and matrix synthesis
hypotheses.result: IGF-1-loaded hydrogel achieved 83.8% defect fill with cartilage-like tissue and high chondrogenic gene expression

title: Mapping cellular senescence, cellular plasticity, and alveolar niche heterogeneity in human lung development
task: Characterize cellular senescence and plasticity during human lung development and neonatal disease
key_results: Single-nucleus RNA-seq and spatial multiplex proteomics identified senescence-associated niches (GLB1+, p21+, GDF15+) lacking classical transcriptional senescence signatures; niche enrichment correlates with disrupted alveolar development, inflammation, and fibrosis; pseudotime analysis reveals altered epithelial fate progression
comments: Protein-dominant senescence phenotype in development is non-canonical; framework for understanding developmental senescence as checkpoint mechanism is novel but requires longitudinal functional studies.

outputs: GLB1, p21, GDF15 protein abundance maps

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physiological developmental senescence operates through protein-dominant rather than transcriptional signatures
hypotheses.result: Senescence-associated proteins abundant in niches but corresponding transcriptional signatures largely absent; non-canonical state consistent with developmental rather than stress-induced senescence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescence-associated niches serve as spatially restricted regulatory checkpoints during normal development but become pathologically sustained in BPD
hypotheses.result: Niches associated with altered epithelial plasticity, disrupted alveolar development, and inflammatory/fibrotic microenvironments; sustained in disease pathology

title: A global atlas of digital dermatology to map innovation and disparities
task: Quantifying bias and redundancy in dermatology image datasets
key_results: Darker skin tones represent 11.0% of 1.1M images, pediatric patients 2.3%; informational novelty has plateaued despite exponential dataset growth
comments: Critical analysis of AI training data bias with actionable roadmap, though the semantic atlas methodology for redundancy measurement could be more formally described.

inputs: 1.1 million dermatology images from 29 public datasets
outputs: Coverage metrics by skin tone, age, condition; redundancy scores; acquisition gap analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Public dermatology datasets are biased toward lighter skin tones and adult populations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Fitzpatrick V-VI only 11.0%, pediatrics 2.3% of archive

title: Large language model surrogates for Bayesian optimization of antibody sequences
task: Bayesian optimization of therapeutic antibody sequences using LLM surrogates
key_results: AbL2BO demonstrates superior sample efficiency and better-calibrated uncertainty than Gaussian process-based BO; competitive or superior optimization across experimental and simulated benchmarks
comments: Novel integration of LLM priors with Bayesian fine-tuning is elegant, but the lack of wet-lab validation of predicted sequences limits impact assessment.

inputs: Antibody sequences; binding assay data; LLM embeddings; Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) parameters
outputs: Optimized antibody sequences; uncertainty estimates (Laplace approximation or MC Dropout); binding affinity predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-based surrogates with Bayesian fine-tuning outperform kernel-based BO for antibody optimization
hypotheses.result: Superior sample efficiency and calibrated uncertainty achieved across benchmarks vs. Gaussian process methods

title: The evolution and transmission dynamics of H3N2 influenza virus identified in a respiratory disease outbreak in companion dogs in Alabama, USA
task: Phylodynamic analysis of H3N2 canine influenza virus reassortment during Alabama outbreak
key_results: Phylogeographic inference reveals discordant segment ancestry: HA/MP/NP/NS/PA from California, NA from Florida, PB1/PB2 from Illinois, strongly indicating reassortment; Alabama strains form tightly clustered monophyletic groups
comments: Well-executed phylogenomic study identifying reassortment mechanism, but limited ecological data on dog movement patterns reduces understanding of transmission routes.

inputs: Whole-genome sequences from 5 Alabama H3N2 CIV isolates; 100 global H3N2 CIV genomes per segment; outbreak metadata (Aug-Oct 2022)
outputs: Phylogenetic trees per segment; phylogeographic inference (ancestral state reconstruction); reassortment events; transmission network

hypotheses.hypothesis: Alabama H3N2 CIV outbreak resulted from reassortment of geographically distinct strains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: distinct gene segments traced to California, Florida, and Illinois source regions, with low phylogeographic concordance

title: Assessing model transferability to predict the state of battery health across independent datasets
task: Evaluating zero-shot transfer of battery state-of-health forecasting models across datasets
key_results: Target-domain degradation regularity (not distributional distance) predicts transfer error; persistence forecast outperformed learned models on most cross-dataset transfers; Monte Carlo Dropout coverage nominal but intervals 10× wider than actual error
comments: Important methodological contribution on cross-dataset benchmark design for prognostics, though the small dataset count and limited model diversity restrict generalizability.

inputs: Lithium-ion battery time-series from three public datasets (ZHU, Makolab, NASA)
outputs: State-of-health predictions; uncertainty intervals; transfer error; alarm thresholds

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dataset distributional distance (MMD, AUC) predicts cross-dataset transfer error
hypotheses.result: Hypothesis rejected; target-domain degradation regularity better explains transfer performance than source-target separability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neural uncertainty estimates generalize across datasets
hypotheses.result: MC Dropout reaches nominal coverage but produces overly wide intervals; alarm policies based on these intervals fail under transfer

title: A novel framework for automated volume quantification of subretinal fluid in central serous chorioretinopathy
task: Automated volume quantification of subretinal fluid in OCT images for central serous chorioretinopathy
key_results: Absolute error minimum 0.0011 mm³, relative error 0.16–7.82% (majority ~6%); MAPE 0.30% with interpolation strategy at sampling factor 2
comments: Sophisticated 3D reconstruction pipeline with solid accuracy, though clinical validation on independent patient cohorts and comparison to manual expert segmentation is absent.

inputs: Radial OCT B-scan images; contour annotations; spatial alignment parameters
outputs: SRF contour extraction; 3D SRF reconstruction; volumetric measurements; sparse-sampling estimates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial alignment and adjacency relationship compensation enable accurate SRF volume from sparse OCT scans
hypotheses.result: MAPE 0.30% achieved with 2× sampling factor interpolation strategy

title: Physics-informed neural surrogate learning predicts cervical cancer progression with mechanistic interpretability
task: Physics-informed neural surrogate learning for cervical cancer progression prediction with interpretable risk stratification
key_results: PI-NSL achieves time-dependent AUC 0.91±0.03 for 2-year PFS prediction, C-index 0.89±0.04 on internal test; external validation AUC 0.87±0.05 (TMC) and 0.86±0.05 (AIIMS); identifies three clinically distinct clusters with significantly different survival (log-rank p<0.001)
comments: Sophisticated mechanistic hybrid framework with large-scale validation across Indian healthcare systems; cluster interpretation is intriguing but mechanistic hypotheses require prospective kinetic studies.

inputs: Clinical data (20,287 patients); tumor-immune-viral dynamics PDEs as soft constraints; routine clinical measurements; treatment metadata
outputs: Patient-specific PDE parameters; spatiotemporal simulations; risk predictions; latent cluster assignments; survival probabilities

hypotheses.hypothesis: Embedding biophysical PDEs as soft constraints improves neural network biological plausibility and clinical trustworthiness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AUC 0.91±0.03 achieved with interpretable clusters reflecting immune activity, proliferation, and peripheral immune phenotypes

title: Transcriptional responses of white-tailed deer to SARS-CoV-2 challenge
task: Temporal transcriptomic profiling of SARS-CoV-2 host response in white-tailed deer
key_results: Regulated antiviral response with early innate immune activation (day 2), cytokine storm inhibition (day 5), reduced differential expression (day 7); 22 conserved upregulated genes at day 2 across species (ADAR, STAT1); limited species-specific conservation at day 5 (5 downregulated, 20 upregulated)
comments: Well-designed longitudinal study on wildlife host response, though single-species transcriptomics and lack of viral load/tissue-level data limit mechanistic insight into infection outcome differences.

inputs: Whole blood from experimentally infected deer; RNA-seq reads; infection timeline (days 2, 5, 7 post-infection); published elk and bison transcriptomes
outputs: Differential gene expression; pathway enrichment (IPA); temporal clusters; cross-species gene conservation; antiviral/cytokine signaling activation profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: White-tailed deer mount a regulated antiviral response with early innate activation and cytokine storm suppression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: temporal remodeling from innate activation (day 2) to hypercytokinemia inhibition (day 5) to resolution (day 7)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conserved host defense mechanisms across wildlife species predict SARS-CoV-2 susceptibility
hypotheses.result: Partially supported: 22 conserved upregulated genes at day 2, but only 25 genes overlap at day 5, indicating divergent molecular strategies among species

title: A lightweight defect grading detection method for quick-frozen dumplings based on improved YOLOv11n
task: Fine-grained defect detection and grading for frozen food quality control
key_results: SCSL-YOLO achieves 95.7% precision, 94.5% recall, 98.6% mAP@0.5; 40.38% parameter reduction and 316.6 FPS inference speed versus YOLOv11n baseline
comments: Well-engineered lightweight detector for industrial application, though evaluation is limited to a single dumpling product category without external validation.

inputs: Quick-frozen dumpling images; defect quality labels (normal, minor, moderate, severe)
outputs: Bounding box predictions; defect grade classification; confidence scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale feature representation and cascaded attention improve defect discrimination under complex backgrounds
hypotheses.result: Precision improved 2.4pp, recall 1.3pp, mAP@0.5 improved 0.5pp over baseline

title: LENS: localized updates facilitate patient-level unlearning in clinical large language models
task: Localized unlearning in clinical large language models to remove patient data while preserving non-deleted patient performance
key_results: LENS confines updates to single four-layer adapter window; deleted patients ROUGE-L reduced from 0.98–0.99 to 0.34 (vs. 0.29–0.39 for existing methods), while non-deleted patients remain at 0.90 (vs. 0.47–0.69 for existing methods); external benchmark accuracy unchanged (<0.02)
comments: Important contribution on targeted unlearning evaluation in clinical LLMs, addressing data deletion requests while mitigating side effects; however, generalization to larger models and other clinical notes beyond MIMIC-III remains unexplored.

inputs: MedGemma-4B-IT fine-tuned on MIMIC-III; deletion request (patient ID); non-deleted patient records
outputs: Updated model weights (four-layer window); ROUGE-L on deleted patients; ROUGE-L on non-deleted patients; external benchmark scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Restricting unlearning updates to localized adapter layers preserves non-deleted patient performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: LENS maintains non-deleted patient ROUGE-L at 0.90 while reducing deleted to 0.34, outperforming existing methods (0.47–0.69)

title: Region-aware CT-to-PET image synthesis using deep learning models for accurate lung cancer localization
task: Region-aware CT-to-PET image synthesis for functional imaging in resource-limited settings with tumor-specific enhancement
key_results: Thoracic detection mAP50: 99.50% (CT), 98.50% (PET); lung segmentation 99.20%; synthetic PET PSNR 20.94 dB, SSIM 72.94%; tumor-aware enhancement SSIM 83.47%, PSNR 25.99 dB; SegResNet segmentation Dice 97.06%, IoU 93.65%
comments: Comprehensive CAD pipeline with strong component-level performance metrics; however, clinical validation on actual PET-deficient patient populations and radiologist feedback on diagnostic utility is absent.

model_io.model: Region-aware CT-to-PET synthesis pipeline (YOLOv11 + CPGAN + SegResNet + fusion)
inputs: Paired CT-PET images; lung and tumor ROI annotations; tumor bounding boxes
outputs: Thoracic region detection; synthetic 18F-FDG PET; tumor segmentation masks; tumor-enhanced PET; fused CT-PET visualizations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tumor-aware synthesis and superimposition improve 18F-FDG PET quality in metabolically active tumor regions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: tumor superimposition improved SSIM to 83.47% and PSNR to 25.99 dB vs. 72.94% and 20.94 dB baseline

title: Machine learning analysis of serum ATR-FTIR spectra for colorectal cancer discrimination
task: Machine learning classification of colorectal cancer from serum ATR-FTIR spectra
key_results: PCA-ANN model achieves 87.5% accuracy, 90.0% sensitivity, 85.0% specificity, AUC 0.941 on internal validation; external evaluation (n=28) yields 85.7% accuracy, AUC 0.920
comments: Interpretable spectroscopy-ML pipeline with reasonable internal performance, but external cohort is very small and lacks demographic balance, limiting clinical translation claims.

inputs: Dried serum ATR-FTIR spectra from 100 CRC cases, 100 controls; fingerprint and high-wavenumber regions; second-derivative spectra
outputs: CRC/control classification; probability scores; variable importance scores; spectral feature contributions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Serum ATR-FTIR spectral signatures discriminate CRC from non-cancer controls
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AUC 0.941 internal, 0.920 external; discriminant features assigned to protein, phosphate, and carbohydrate vibrations

title: An integrated multimodal neural network framework for early diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and mild cognitive impairment combining genomic, neuroimaging, and behavioral modalities
task: Multimodal deep learning for early Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment detection integrating genomics, neuroimaging, and behavioral data
key_results: Multimodal model exceeds unimodal alternatives in predictive efficacy and resilience on ADNI and UK Biobank harmonized data; attention-driven modality gating identifies significant multimodal biomarkers for early AD/MCI diagnosis
comments: Well-motivated multimodal fusion approach with attention-based interpretability, but results are presented qualitatively without specific performance metrics, hindering reproducibility assessment.

model_io.model: Multimodal deep learning framework (3D-CNN + DNN + behavioral pathway + modality gating)
inputs: MRI morphology (3D structural data); genetic variants (SNP arrays); behavioral assessments and cognitive scores; longitudinal clinical labels (AD/MCI/controls)
outputs: AD/MCI risk predictions; attention weights per modality; latent biomarker representations; clinical interpretability scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of genomic, neuroimaging, and behavioral data via attention-driven modality gating improves early AD/MCI detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: multimodal model outperforms unimodal approaches; modality gating identifies significant multimodal biomarkers

title: ECG foundation models for cardiovascular screening in a cohort of young competitive athletes
task: Evaluating ECG foundation model generalization from clinical populations to athlete-specific cardiac screening
key_results: PhysioNet/CinC 2021 performance AUROC 0.97, AUPRC 0.57, sensitivity 0.89; on 43 athlete ECGs, ECGFounder best (AUROC 0.84, AUPRC 0.72, sensitivity 0.57); sinus bradycardia AUROC 0.87, sinus arrhythmia AUROC 0.95
comments: Critical domain-shift analysis for clinical AI deployment, but the small athlete cohort (n=43) and rare-class instability limit confidence in athlete-specific performance claims.

inputs: PhysioNet/CinC 2021 ECG dataset (87,662 samples); athlete ECGs (n=43, expert-annotated); cardiac condition labels
outputs: ECG interpretation predictions; AUROC/AUPRC scores; per-label sensitivity; domain-specific performance metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: ECG foundation models trained on general clinical populations generalize to athlete populations without performance loss
hypotheses.result: Hypothesis rejected: significant domain shift observed; AUROC dropped from 0.97 to 0.84; athlete-specific findings underdetected relative to general population

title: Accelerating high-throughput catalyst screening by direct generation of equilibrium adsorption structures
task: Accelerate catalyst screening by generating equilibrium adsorption structures
key_results: DBCata achieves 0.035 Å MAE (70% lower than SOTA); DFT accuracy within 0.1 eV in 94% of cases
comments: Combines deep generative models with periodic Brownian bridges; avoids explicit energy/force supervision, enabling efficient high-throughput screening.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Limited training data from near-equilibrium structures causes unreliable predictions
hypotheses.result: DBCata trained on manifold transition outperforms conventional ML potentials

title: A label-free domain-knowledge-informed framework for transferability evaluation of synthetic accessibility scoring in energetic chemical space
task: Evaluate synthetic accessibility scoring transferability in energetic chemical space
key_results: SAscore and BR-SAScore show most consistent transferability; RDX benchmark reveals high-energy, easy-to-synthesize space: heteroatom-rich linkages with moderate scaffold complexity
comments: Label-free domain-knowledge framework using unsupervised learning on 28,195 molecules; validates without synthesis difficulty annotations.

model_io.model: Multi-stage screening + unsupervised SA model evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unsupervised evaluation enables SA transferability assessment without labeled synthesis data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: domain-knowledge-based validation identifies robust scoring methods

title: A complete-coverage path-planning algorithm based on local path cost
task: Plan complete-coverage paths for mobile robots in complex environments
key_results: CCPP-LPC improves path length and reduces repeated coverage ratio vs. six SOTA heuristics; better convergence, fewer local optima, reduced turning maneuvers
comments: Uses local path cost evaluation and adaptive dual-guided perturbation node selection; tested on four simulated and four real-environment maps.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local path cost guidance improves convergence and path optimality in CCPP
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CCPP-LPC achieves best performance across path length and coverage metrics

title: Traffic signs recognition for advanced driver assistance systems using deep learning
task: Recognize traffic signs for advanced driver assistance systems
key_results: Custom CNN 97.82% validation (vs. 94–96% baseline); Xception 92.95%, YOLOv11 mAP50=97%; DeiT-Tiny 96.61% accuracy, 15× smaller than ViT-B/16, superior precision/recall/F1
comments: Benchmarks and extends GTSRB evaluation; transformer-based and detection-based models outperform traditional CNNs; DeiT-Tiny offers parameter efficiency, YOLOv11 offers real-time localization for ADAS.

model_io.model: Multiple architectures (Custom CNN, VGG16, AlexNet, Xception, YOLOv11, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer-based and detection-based models outperform CNN baselines for traffic sign recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DeiT-Tiny and YOLOv11 achieve comparable or superior accuracy with better efficiency/localization

title: Robust microseismic arrival picking for hydraulic fracturing monitoring using a deep orthogonal collaborative ensemble network
task: Pick microseismic arrivals robustly in hydraulic fracturing monitoring
key_results: DOCE-Net outperforms individual base learners (U-Net, Res-LSTM, TransNet), especially under low SNR; superior cross-domain generalization after fine-tuning on unseen monitoring domain
comments: Deep orthogonal collaborative ensemble with orthogonality constraint reducing redundancy; semblance-based decision-level fusion exploits prediction consistency.

model_io.model: DOCE-Net (ensemble of U-Net, Res-LSTM, TransNet + orthogonal fusion)
outputs: P/S arrival time picks with confidence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orthogonal ensemble learning with multi-trace coherence improves microseismic picking robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DOCE-Net achieves higher accuracy under low SNR and cross-domain scenarios

title: Multimodal emotion recognition and feedback adaptation for personalized music therapy
task: Adapt music therapy via multimodal emotion recognition and feedback optimization
key_results: Emotion recognition 90.1% accuracy, F1=89.6%; music emotion MAE 0.096 (valence), 0.101 (arousal), correlation 0.861; recommendation HR@10=84.2%, NDCG@10=80.5%; target-state distance reduction 0.214 (vs. 0.186 for Tensor Fusion)
comments: Cross-modal Transformer fuses facial/speech/physiological signals; VGGish + dual-task learning extracts music features; DQN-based optimization generates personalized interventions; clinical efficacy unvalidated.

inputs: facial/speech/physiological signals, music library, target emotional state
outputs: personalized music recommendations with therapeutic utility scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal emotion recognition and feedback adaptation enable personalized music therapy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieves 90.1% emotion accuracy and 0.214 target-state distance reduction; clinical efficacy remains unexplored

title: Functional time series forecasting of air temperature using a functional autoregressive model with electricity demand as an exogenous variable
task: Forecast air temperature using functional time series with exogenous variables
key_results: FARX(1) minimizes FAR(1) forecasting error across all scenarios; electricity demand as exogenous variable improves accuracy; Fourier basis representation captures diurnal dynamics
comments: Extends FAR(1) with electricity demand; smoother functional curves handle nonlinearity and periodicity better than discrete ARIMA/VAR/ANN baselines.

inputs: hourly AT, electricity demand, meteorological data
outputs: daily AT curve forecasts (1–4 weeks ahead)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exogenous electricity demand variable improves functional autoregressive forecasting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: FARX(1) outperforms FAR(1) and conventional models on MASE, sMAPE, RMSE

title: Multidimensional cognitive assessment of preservice middle school mathematics teachers’ proportional reasoning skills
task: Assess preservice teachers' proportional reasoning skills using diagnostic classification
key_results: Only ~33% PSTs mastered all three attributes (ratios, proportions, nonproportional relationships); ~20% mastered none; major difficulties: numerically complex ratios, real-world attributes, additive vs. multiplicative reasoning
comments: HDCM applied to 747 PSTs; 45-item diagnostic test reveals fine-grained skill gaps.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Proportional reasoning requires mastery of three coupled attributes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: only ~33% achieved full mastery; skill gaps identified for intervention design

title: A hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-attention model optimized by an improved sparrow search algorithm for identity authentication and anomaly detection in electricity markets
task: Authenticate electricity market users and detect anomalies via deep learning
key_results: Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-attention achieves 98.71% accuracy, F1=98.43% on simulated dataset; improved sparrow search (Tent chaos + adaptive inertia + Cauchy-Gaussian perturbation) outperforms standard optimization
comments: Bimodal feature engineering combines behavioral and network traffic statistics; hyperparameter tuning via enhanced sparrow search algorithm.

inputs: user behavioral features, network traffic statistics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Improved sparrow search addresses deep model hyperparameter sensitivity for identity authentication
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ablation studies validate contribution of each component; stable performance under noise

title: A Bayesian-evolutionary game framework for robust multi-agent workforce scheduling in resilient supply chains
task: Allocate workforce under supply-chain disruptions via game-theoretic optimization
key_results: BEHG-RSO achieves 93.6% workforce utilization, 9.9% cost reduction vs. MARL, 25.5% faster recovery time
comments: Bayesian-evolutionary hybrid game with robust stochastic optimization; partner reliability and cooperation shares inform scheduling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-design of Bayesian reliability estimates and evolutionary cooperation improves scheduling robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ablation studies characterize performance trade-offs across disruption scenarios

title: Stability analysis of networked control systems using three-layer delay modelling
task: Analyze stability of networked control systems with multi-layer delays
key_results: Derives exact Maximum Allowable Communication Delay (MACD) using Phase Margin criteria; layer-aware Smith Predictor compensates transport delays but physical device execution delays remain
comments: Decouples deterministic intra-device delays from multi-layer protocol delays; identifies physical performance boundaries.

model_io.model: Smith Predictor with layer-aware delay model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Communication delays can be compensated but device execution delays establish ultimate performance boundary
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: layer-wise decomposition enables precise delay assessment

title: Trigonometric cubic $$\mathscr {B}$$ -spline collocation approach for system of singularly perturbed turning point problem with integral boundary conditions
task: Solve singularly perturbed turning point problems with integral boundary conditions
key_results: Trigonometric cubic B-spline collocation achieves near second-order convergence; outperforms FDM and standard cubic B-spline methods
comments: Uses Shishkin mesh to capture boundary layers at both domain ends; trapezoidal rule discretizes integral BCs.

model_io.model: Trigonometric cubic B-spline collocation on Shishkin mesh

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trigonometric basis functions better capture layer behavior in SPTPPs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieves close to second-order convergence with improved accuracy vs. cubic B-spline

title: Systematic evaluation of machine learning and explainable AI for NOx emission prediction in gas turbine systems
task: Predict NOx emissions in gas turbine systems with interpretable ML
key_results: Bayesian-optimized LightGBM achieves R²=0.8928, RMSE=3.7694; dominant factors: ambient temp, turbine inlet temp, exhaust pressure, after-turbine temp
